name: Human project owners create and edit requirements drafts
summary: In simple mode the signed-in project owner creates and edits requirements drafts under current membership, governance and content checks. Contributors propose changes to protected human drafts. Failed-creation recovery lists at most 20 intents with counts and one complete export/membership proof. Missing prewrite receipts have a distinct nothing-written message and an account/request-bound retained clear audit; damaged or special files cannot block the reader. Valid title/time metadata is displayed when available. Recovery listing preserves fixed enable-editing and operator-repair advice; CREATE keeps its own canonical refusal sentences, while bounded receipt reads hide file paths at their source; transient native reads advise reload. Clearing still needs current locks, exact receipt hash and native absence; allocated or uncertain content is not invented. Governed/host policies and machine credential authority are unchanged.
